findings.evidence: xiLC * (M² - (1 - xiLC) M²) = xiLC * (xiLC * M²) = xiLC² M²; the pre-PR proof of the same statement was `rw [tMinElastic_def, neg_div, neg_nonpos]; exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg xiLC) (sq_nonneg M)) (sub_nonneg.mpr h)`.
findings.fix: `have h : xiLC * (M ^ 2 - (1 - xiLC) * M ^ 2) = xiLC ^ 2 * M ^ 2 := by ring` then `rw [h]; positivity` (or keep the pre-PR `div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _))` proof off `tMinElastic_def`).
findings.issue: `tMinElastic_nonpos` now discharges `0 ≤ xiLC * (M ^ 2 - (1 - xiLC) * M ^ 2)` with `nlinarith [sq_nonneg xiLC, sq_nonneg M, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg xiLC) (sq_nonneg M)]`. The goal is `ring`-equal to `0 ≤ xiLC ^ 2 * M ^ 2`, so nonlinear search obscures the (docstring-asserted) fact that the elastic numerator is exactly ξ²M², and the first two hints are unused.

findings.evidence: `LightConeBasis.smul_add_smul_add_eq_iff {a b : R} {w v : V} (hw : w ∈ L.transverse) : a • L.nPlus + b • L.nMinus + w = v ↔ a = L.plus v ∧ b = L.minus v ∧ w = L.transverseProj v` at EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/LightConeBasis.lean:232.
findings.fix: Prove `hpT : pT ∈ L.transverse` (`sub_mem (L.transverse.smul_mem _ (L.isProj_transverseProj.map_mem _)) (L.transverse.smul_mem _ he)`) and one explicit `have : K.pPrime = a • L.nPlus + c • L.nMinus + pT := rfl`, then `obtain ⟨hKp, hKm, hKT⟩ := (L.smul_add_smul_add_eq_iff hpT).1 this.symm`; `hep`, `hem`, `heT` then become unnecessary.
findings.issue: `hKp`, `hKm`, `hKT` re-derive the three light-cone components of the constructed `K.pPrime = a • n₊ + c • n₋ + pT` with three separate `simp [K, pT, …]` calls that depend on simp unfolding the structure literal `K` and re-proving transversality of `pT` from `hep`/`hem`/`heT`. The repo already has the uniqueness lemma that yields all three at once.

summary: Two proof-quality issues: the elastic sign lemma regressed from a direct `div_nonneg` argument to an `nlinarith` with redundant hints that hides a plain `ring` identity, and the existence witness recomputes light-cone components with three ad-hoc `simp` calls on the structure literal instead of using the existing uniqueness lemma.
